content: Write a jQuery script that changes an image when the user hovers over it.
Can you add a smooth transition effect when the image changes?
This is great! Can you add some information on how to change the speed of the transition effect? I would like it to be slower.
Hey, that script is awesome! Can you give me more details on how to add a fade-in and fade-out effect when the image changes? I think it would add more style to it.
This is great! The fade-in and fade-out effect really added some style. Can you also show me how to add a zoom-in effect when the image changes? It would make the transition even more impressive.
